findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "plan_trip" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Build a complete day-by-day trip in one call using Dreamfare's own planner: real venues (with opening hours), a stay, activities from partner inventory, the tra…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_trip, search_places, search_flights, get_details, compare_options, import_video, import_text, get_import, list_crew, read_trip_chat · Private data: mark_stop_booked, travel_extras, import_file, get_profile, save_place, add_receipt · Public sink: mark_stop_booked, travel_extras, import_video, import_text, get_import, invite_to_trip, post_trip_chat, share_trip, add_receipt · Destructive: edit_trip, delete_trip, manage_packing, search_stays, import_video, manage_travel_tips, manage_saved_places, manage_crew.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_trip, search_places, search_flights, get_details, compare_options, import_video, import_text, get_import, list_crew, read_trip_chat · Private data: mark_stop_booked, travel_extras, import_file, get_profile, save_place, add_receipt · Public sink: mark_stop_booked, travel_extras, import_video, import_text, get_import, invite_to_trip, post_trip_chat, share_trip, add_receipt · Destructive: edit_trip, delete_trip, manage_packing, search_stays, import_video, manage_travel_tips, manage_saved_places, manage_crew

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
